Hushthorn camera-scan test barcodes

Open this page on a laptop or monitor (screen brightness high, no glare), then point your phone's Hushthorn scanner at one barcode at a time. Or print it. Each card says what should happen. These are fixtures for tests/camera-scan-test-plan.md. Titles are the expected matches and were not verified against Open Library when this page was made.

BC-A Normal single scan.

Expect: Found. Title contains “Gatsby” (The Great Gatsby, Scribner pb).

BC-B Second book for multi-scan.

Expect: Found. Title contains “1984” or “Nineteen Eighty-Four”.

BC-C Third book for multi-scan.

Expect: Found. Title contains “Harry Potter”.

BC-D Fourth book for multi-scan.

Expect: Found. Title contains “Hobbit”.

BC-X Not-found path.

Expect: Valid ISBN-13 that is probably unknown to Open Library: message “ISBN … not in the archives”. If it IS found, note the title and pick another.

BC-N1 Non-ISBN barcode.

Expect: IGNORED: valid EAN-13 but not 978/979. Nothing happens; status stays “Point at the barcode…”.

BC-N2 Short barcode.

Expect: IGNORED: EAN-8. Nothing happens. (The native detector only asks for ean_13.)
